meta.note: Generated by knowledge/builders/build-monster-db.py: how this character's fights went (its runs alone; knowledge/common/monster-db.json holds the monsters' own facts, over every character). bosses / encounters: per boss and encounter by ascension; threat_by_asc: per monster id by ascension (merged into the monster DB's entries). threat: hp_loss_won = entry HP - HP on the last combat-player snapshot (includes lower HP on a same-room closing screen, never replaces pre-heal HP with higher healed HP; includes self-damage cards), net_hp_loss_won = entry HP - HP after the fight (after end-of-combat heals).
